kitOverride: For sound-car-v1 use the job-generated KIT-HARDWARE-REFERENCE.json bound to its design hash. The source kit uses Pololu #1098 motors and #1420 60 mm wheels; this older #992 candidate is not substituted into that kit.

components.name: Raspberry Pi Pico or Pico H, original non-wireless RP2040 board
components.notes: GP numbers are not physical header numbers. Firmware is not tested on this board. USB supplies the logic domain; never drive motors from Pico 3V3.

components.name: Adafruit MAX4466 Electret Microphone Amplifier
components.notes: Use 3.3V, not the module's allowed 5V, to keep its rail-to-rail output within the Pico ADC domain. Relative RMS measurement only; no SPL calibration or reliable disconnect diagnosis.

components.name: Pololu DRV8833 Dual Motor Driver Carrier
components.notes: Continuous rating is thermally dependent; peak is not continuous. Board SLP is pulled high. Inputs have internal pull-downs. FLT is open-drain, active low. Current limiting is disabled by the default carrier configuration.

components.name: Pololu 100:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor LP 6V
components.notes: Candidate only. Stall values are theoretical, not usable continuous torque. Operating at a different pack voltage requires new characterization. No physical mass, gear efficiency, load curve, wheel interface or bracket fit has been confirmed.

components.name: Separately fused and switched low-voltage motor supply; chemistry and exact SKU pending
components.notes: A preassembled 4-cell NiMH holder/pack is one option, not a mandate or proven selection. Verify maximum voltage, current, polarity, fuse, holder and switch ratings first. No lithium charging circuitry is supplied. Do not join motor VIN to Pico 3V3/VSYS/VBUS.

additionalRequiredItems: Compatible wheels/hubs plus caster or equivalent passive support; shaft fit unresolved
Motor mounts, board mounts, fasteners and strain relief matched to measured components
Normally-open ARM button and normally-closed STOP sensing loop
Independent accessible DC-rated motor-power disconnect and appropriate fuse
Properly rated wire/connectors, insulated secure terminals and common ground
USB logic supply for Pico during bench commissioning
releaseBlockers: Dimensions/mounting interfaces measured or read from exact revision drawings
Actual power-source maximum voltage, fuse, switch/wire ratings and motor current budget selected
Usable torque, traction, temperature and motor direction observed on bench
Physical stop distance and watchdog/fault behavior tested
Microphone motor-self-noise feedback excluded through a negative-control test
Physical toy age/small-parts and moving-part hazards reviewed
